arxiv-1809-00951.title: Generation of rogue waves in space dusty plasmas Journal: “High Energy Density Physics"
arxiv-1809-00951.creator: M.H. Rahman ∗ , A. Mannan, N.A. Chowdhury, and A.A. Mamun
arxiv-1809-00951.description: Abstract The basic features of dust-acoustic (DA) waves (DAWs) in four component dusty plasma system (containing inertial cold and hot dust grains, inertialess non-extensive ions and electrons) have been theoretically investigated by deriving the nonlinear Schrödinger equation. The analytic analysis under consideration demonstrates two types of modes, namely, fast and slow DA modes.

arxiv-2012-04460.title: Planet cartography with neural learned regularization
arxiv-2012-04460.creator: A. Asensio Ramos, E. Pallé
arxiv-2012-04460.description: Abstract Aims. Finding potential life harboring exo-Earths is one of the aims of exoplanetary science with the use of future telescopes. Detecting signatures of life in exoplanets will likely first be accomplished by determining the bulk composition of the planetary atmosphere via reflected/transmitted spectroscopy.

arxiv-2103-09679.title: Pulse shape simulation of p-type Point Contact Germanium Detector for The MAJORONA DEMONSTRATOR Experiment
arxiv-2103-09679.creator: V. Singh
arxiv-2103-09679.description: Abstract In the rare physics events search, liquid and solid detector plays an important role. Its analysis is based on the detection of excess events over the expected background or on the detection of an annual event rate modulation. Germanium detectors sensitivities have been demonstrated as efficient means to probe Weakly Interacting Massive Particles (WIMPs).

arxiv-2208-07295.creator: Rakhi Pratihar, Tovohery Hajatiana Randrianarisoa
arxiv-2208-07295.description: Abstract We consider the class of linear antipodal two-weight rank metric codes and discuss their properties and characterization in terms of t t -spreads. It is shown that the dimension of such codes is 2 2 and the minimum rank distance is at least half of the length. We construct antipodal two-weight rank metric codes from certain MRD codes.

arxiv-2307-06539.title: Domain Wall Solution Arising in Abelian Higgs Model Subject to Born-Infeld Theory of Electrodynamics
arxiv-2307-06539.creator: Lei CaoSchool of Mathematics and StatisticsHenan UniversityKaifeng, Henan 475004, PR China, Xiao Chen School of Mathematics and Information ScienceHenan University of Economics and LawZhengzhou, Henan 450016, PR China
arxiv-2307-06539.description: Abstract In this note we research the Abelian Higgs model subject to the Born-Infeld theory of electrodynamics for which the BPS equations can be reduced into a quasi-linear differential equation. We show that the equation exists a unique solution under two interesting boundary conditions which realize the corresponding phase transition.

arxiv-2409-00392.description: Abstract Context. Turbulence is a key component of molecular cloud structure. It is usually described by a cascade of energy down to the dissipation scale. The power spectrum for subsonic incompressible turbulence is ∝ k − 5 / 3 \propto k^{-5/3} , while for supersonic turbulence it is ∝ k − 2 \propto k^{-2} . Aims.

arxiv-2501-14495.title: BILLNET: A Binarized Conv3D-LSTM Network with Logic-gated residual architecture for hardware-efficient video inference
arxiv-2501-14495.creator: Van Thien Nguyen, William Guicquero and Gilles Sicard
arxiv-2501-14495.description: Abstract Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and 3D convolution (Conv3D) show impressive results for many video-based applications but require large memory and intensive computing. Motivated by recent works on hardware-algorithmic co-design towards efficient inference, we propose a compact binarized Conv3D-LSTM model architecture called BILLNET, compatible with a highly resource-constrained hardware.

arxiv-2505-23592.title: A Modern Theory of Cross-Validation through the Lens of Stability
arxiv-2505-23592.creator: Jing Lei
arxiv-2505-23592.description: Abstract Modern data analysis and statistical learning are characterized by two defining features: complex data structures and black-box algorithms. The complexity of data structures arises from advanced data collection technologies and data-sharing infrastructures, such as imaging, remote sensing, wearable devices, and genomic sequencing.

arxiv-2508-00507.title: Court of LLMs: Evidence-Augmented Generation via Multi-LLM Collaboration for Text-Attributed Graph Anomaly Detection Conference: Proceedings of the 33rd ACM International Conference on Multimedia; October 27–31, 2025; Dublin, Ireland Proceedings of the 33rd ACM International Conference on Multimedia

arxiv-2508-00507.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yiming Xu, Jiarun Chen, Zhen Peng, Zihan Chen, Qika Lin, Lan Ma, Bin Shi, Bo Dong. The natural combination of intricate topological structures and rich textual information in text-attributed graphs (TAGs) opens up a novel perspective for graph anomaly detection (GAD).

arxiv-2510-02832.title: A supermassive black hole under the radar: repeating X-ray variability in a Seyfert galaxy
arxiv-2510-02832.creator: Matteo Imbrogno, Andrea Sacchi ⋆, Giovanni Miniutti, Francesco Tombesi, Gian Luca Israel, Enrico Piconcelli, Roberta Amato
arxiv-2510-02832.description: Abstract In the last few years, a few supermassive black holes (SMBHs) have shown short-term (of the order of hours) X-ray variability. Given the limited size of the sample, every new addition to this class of SMBHs can bring invaluable information.

britannica-1911-stofflet-jean-nicolas.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-stofflet-jean-nicolas.description: Article 'Stofflet, Jean Nicolas' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 25), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. of Beaupréau, Laval and Antrain. Charette, and the reverses sustained by the Vendéan arms, led him to give in his submission and to accept the terms of the treaty of La Jaunaie (May 2, 1795).

MSCs can migrate to tissue injury areas to contribute to immune...

pmc-11348119.title: Violet Light Effects on the Circadian Rest–Activity Rhythm and the Visual System
pmc-11348119.creator: Teresa Domínguez-Valdés, Cristina Bonnin-Arias, Cristina Alvarez-Peregrina, Beatriz G Galvez, Miguel Angel Sanchez-Tena, Francisco Germain, Pedro de la Villa, Celia Sánchez-Ramos, Mirjam Münch
pmc-11348119.description: Background: Rooms illuminated by “black light” (<400 nm wavelength) has become popular, but there is not enough scientific evidence to support its implementation. This study aims to assess the effects of violet light (392 nm) on the circadian rest–activity rhythm and the visual system through animal experimentation.

pmc-11354756.title: Biological Roles of Lipids in Rice
pmc-11354756.creator: Kun Zhou, Zhengliang Luo, Weidong Huang, Zemin Liu, Xuexue Miao, Shuhua Tao, Jiemin Wang, Jian Zhang, Shiyi Wang, Xiaoshan Zeng, Elena Azzini
pmc-11354756.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Lipids are organic nonpolar molecules with essential biological and economic importance. While the genetic pathways and regulatory networks of lipid biosynthesis and metabolism have been extensively studied and thoroughly reviewed in oil crops such as soybeans, less attention has been paid to the biological roles of lipids in rice, a staple food for the global population and a model species for plant molecular biology research, leaving a considerable knowledge gap in the biological roles of lipids.

pmc-11484248.title: Long-Term Efficacy of Posterior Neurectomy in Anterior Cutaneous Nerve Entrapment Syndrome
pmc-11484248.creator: Tom ten Have, Monica L. Y. E. Jacobs, Marc R. M. Scheltinga, Willem A. R. Zwaans, Rudi M. H. Roumen
pmc-11484248.description: ObjectiveTo analyze long-term treatment outcomes of a posterior neurectomy in a large cohort of patients with anterior cutaneous nerve entrapment syndrome (ACNES).Summary Background DataThe current step-up treatment approach for ACNES involves abdominal wall tender point injections, pulsed radiofrequency, and neurectomy. If an anterior neurectomy fails or pain reoccurs, a posterior neurectomy is considered as a final surgical option.

pmc-11727800.title: Effect of Temperature Gradient and Cooling Rate on the Solidification of Iron: A Molecular Dynamics Study
pmc-11727800.creator: Qin Qin, Weizhuang Li, Wenrui Wang, Dongyue Li, Lu Xie, Balázs Illés
pmc-11727800.description: In this study, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations were employed to compare the effects of different solidification conditions on the solidification behaviour, stress distribution, and degree of crystallization of iron. The results indicate significant differences in nucleation and microstructural evolution between the two solidification methods. In the homogeneous temperature field, the solidification of iron is characterized by instantaneous nucleation.

pmc-12731642.title: Shagreen Patch in Tuberous Sclerosis Complex at High-Frequency Ultrasound
pmc-12731642.creator: Corrado Tagliati, Ximena Wortsman, Giorgio Treglia
pmc-12731642.description: We present a case of a 19-year-old female patient with tuberous sclerosis complex and a shagreen patch on her left dorsal region. Decreased echogenicity and increased thickness of the dermis were shown by high-frequency ultrasound. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first reported ultrasound image of a shagreen patch.

pmc-13225065.title: A method of comprehensive sequencing analysis of the small RNA fragmentome (RiboMarker)
pmc-13225065.creator: Rachel C Clark, Aidan C Manning, Jonathan M Howard, Sergio Barberán-Soler, Sergei A Kazakov

pmc-13662709.title: Preparation for bias conversations among Black/African American, Latinx, and Asian parent‐adolescent dyads: A qualitative content analysis of observational data
pmc-13662709.creator: Frances M Lobo, Michelle Y Martin Romero, Paula Sanchez‐Hernandez, Kimberly Cang, Lisa Kiang, Stephanie Irby Coard, Gabriela Livas
pmc-13662709.description: Preparation for bias conversations may be critical in raising youth awareness of racial‐ethnic discrimination, fostering a strong racial‐ethnic identity, and teaching them how to cope or respond to racialized stressors. However, the literature relies almost exclusively on survey approaches, limiting understanding of how these conversations actually unfold in real time.

pmc-13685153.title: Changes in the microbial spectrum and antimicrobial resistance of bloodstream infections in intensive care units before and during the COVID-19 pandemic
pmc-13685153.creator: Sümeyye Bayram, Funda Şimşek, Çiğdem Arabacı, Zekeriya Ervatan
pmc-13685153.description: BackgroundBloodstream infections (BSIs) are major infectious conditions associated with high morbidity and mortality, particularly in intensive care units (ICUs). In critically ill patients, early and appropriate empirical antimicrobial therapy plays an important role in preventing adverse clinical outcomes. However, the increasing burden of antimicrobial resistance necessitates that empirical treatment strategies be continuously reassessed based on up-to-date local resistance data.

uslaw-usc-t36-s22504.description: United States Code, Title 36 (Patriotic And National Observances, Ceremonies, And Organizations); Part B (Organizations); Chapter 225 (American War Mothers). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The corporation may— (1) adopt a constitution, bylaws, and regulations; (2) adopt and alter a corporate seal; (3) adopt emblems and badges; (4) establish and maintain offices to conduct its activities; (5) establish State, territorial, and local.
